ENCRYPTION_ON: Files you add here are now encrypted.
ENCRYPTION_OFF: Files you add here are no longer encrypted.
ENCRYPTED: Encrypted {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}.
NO_KEYS: Nobody here has shared an encryption key with you yet, so nothing was attached.
SOME_WITHOUT_KEYS: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} here can't open these: no saved key.
NOT_FOR_YOU: This file wasn't encrypted for your key.
DECRYPT_FAILED: The file couldn't be downloaded or opened.
YOUR_KEY_SUBTITLE: Share it so people can send you encrypted files. Compare fingerprints in person to be sure.
KEY_COPIED: Key copied. Paste it in a chat.
CONTACTS_EMPTY: No saved keys yet. Long-press a message with someone's key and pick Save Encryption Key.
